Name: Naamah, the Ammonitess
Summary: Naamah, an Ammonitess, was the mother of Rehoboam, who was forty-one when he began to reign seventeen years in Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Naamah is named only as Rehoboam's mother in the record of his reign.
LifeLesson: A mother's identity is part of a king's story, even in a single line.
